title: bundled cedar dispatcher evaluates a context-gated forbid against the snapshot
manifest_yaml:
agent_control_specification_version: 0.4.0-alpha.1
policies:
  p:
    type: cedar
    policy_set: |
      @id("amount_too_high")
      forbid(principal, action, resource) when {
        context has tool_call && context.tool_call has args &&
        context.tool_call.args has amount && context.tool_call.args.amount > 100
      };
      permit(principal, action, resource);
intervention_points:
  pre_tool_call:
    tool_name_from: $snap.tool_call.name
    policy:
      id: p
    policy_target: $snap.tool_call.args
tools:
  pay:
    type: Tool
